response:
feat(CC-0117): replace static ExternalSecrets with operator projection

Replace the static, namespace-pinned ExternalSecrets with per-ControlPlane
projection driven by the c5c3 operator, so a single cluster can host the
admin credentials of multiple ControlPlanes without manifest edits.

- Add the AdminPassword sub-reconciler (reconcile_adminpassword.go): in
  managed mode it create-or-updates a per-ControlPlane, OpenBao-backed
  ExternalSecret named "{keystone}-admin-credentials" in the ControlPlane's
  child namespace, owner-referenced for GC, reading the keystone-name-scoped
  path "bootstrap/{namespace}/{keystone}/admin" so it matches the seeder and
  the keystone-operator Model B rotation PushSecret
- Drive a new AdminPasswordReady sub-condition that mirrors the
  ExternalSecret's Ready status and requeues (adminPasswordRequeueAfter,
  10s) until ESO has synced; in brownfield mode (Database.ClusterRef == nil)
  the operator projects no ExternalSecret and reports Ready immediately
- Run AdminPassword before Keystone in the reconcile chain so the
  admin-password ExternalSecret exists before the projected Keystone child
  references it, and register the condition in subConditionTypes and the
  instrumentation drift-guard map
- Add effectiveAdminPasswordSecretRef: the operator-owned per-ControlPlane
  Secret in managed mode, the user-supplied passwordSecretRef in brownfield;
  point the projected Keystone bootstrap ref, readAdminPassword, and the
  Secret-name field indexer/extractor at this effective ref
- Remove the three static production ExternalSecrets (keystone-admin,
  mariadb-root-password, k-orc-clouds-yaml) from deploy/eso; the eso
  kustomization now ships only the ClusterSecretStore
- Add kind-only ExternalSecret shims for keystone-admin and
  mariadb-root-password so standalone/Quick Start flows keep working while
  the production stack ships none
- Drop the obsolete global default clouds.yaml mount from the K-ORC
  HelmRelease and update namespaces.yaml: orc-system no longer hosts a
  static k-orc-clouds-yaml ExternalSecret (each K-ORC CR carries a
  per-resource CloudCredentialsRef resolved in its own namespace)
- Note in the OpenBao eso-control-plane / eso-management policies that the
  operator-projected admin-password read is already covered by the existing
  "kv-v2/data/bootstrap/*" grant, read-only, with no widening
- Update the bootstrap seed script and deploy-infra.sh comments to reflect
  the operator-projected admin password and the kind-only shim
- Add reconcile_adminpassword_test.go unit tests and a managed-mode extractor
  test; wire the admin-password ExternalSecret simulation into the
  integration suite; update keystone, korc, and credential-invariant tests
  to assert the operator-owned per-CP admin-password Secret
- Add the admin-password-scoping chainsaw E2E suite and repoint the
  full-controlplane-keystone verify Job and credential-chain assertions to
  the control-plane (openstack) namespace
- Refresh the ControlPlane CRD/reconciler reference, quick-start, and
  infrastructure/openbao docs to describe operator-projected admin passwords
